capability: Every spec must carry a version, or the project fails its checks
Revising a spec drifts every inventory row pinned to it
A capability cannot be marked built without a verify command
Verify commands must be single invocations a human can run by hand
Duplicate IDs and dangling spec references are caught
Verification runs each built capability's command and reports honestly
New specs, slices and spikes scaffold from templates, ready to check
The inventory reports what is built, in progress and planned
Every skill stays within the portable Agent Skills subset
One command installs sprout and wires up every agent's entry point
Documents cannot carry a status outside their kind's lifecycle
One command names the current loop, its reason, the blocker and the next action
The same artifacts always resolve to the same position, by published precedence
Empty, uninitialised and unparseable projects all yield a position or a clear refusal
The ledger is CSV, so punctuation in any field survives without hand-escaping
Every capability names the slice delivering it, and dangling references are caught
Missing columns and malformed rows are reported with their line numbers
A slice's state is computed from the rows naming it, never declared
A slice that declares a status is rejected, so the self-report cannot return
Routing follows the ledger, so changing a row changes the reported loop
